instruction: Set up the Ubuntu firewall to allow only SSH access on port 22, blocking all other incoming connections.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because it requires configuring UFW (Uncomplicated Firewall) or iptables rules, and proper verification would require testing network connections from external sources to ensure the firewall rules are working correctly. The OSWorld environment cannot reliably test network-level security configurations, as this would require simulating external connection attempts and verifying packet filtering behavior.

llm_judge_reasons: Task correctly marked as infeasible using the infeasible() evaluator function
Proper verification of firewall configuration requires network-level testing (external connection probes to verify packet filtering), which is outside the scope of the OSWorld desktop environment
While firewall configuration files (UFW status, iptables rules) could be read, this would only verify configuration syntax, not actual security behavior
The metadata correctly explains why verification is infeasible: requires testing network connections from external sources to ensure firewall rules are working correctly
